subject: general
question:
In this question, four sets of name and address are given out of which two are exactly same. It is required to find out these two combinations and mark the correct answer accordingly.

1. Jabalpur Division First floor in campus Head Post Office Civil Line Jabalpur - 482001

2. Jabalpur Division First floor in campus Head Post Office Civil Line Jabalpur - 482001

3. Jabalpur Division First floor in campus Head Post Office Civil Line Jabalpur - 480001

4. Jabalpur Division First floor in campus Head Post Office Civil Lane Jabalpur - 482001
solution:
Compare each address carefully.

 
 

 Option
 Address
 Matching
 
 

 1
 
 
Jabalpur Division First floor in campus Head Post Office Civil Line Jabalpur - 482001

 
 Exactly same as Address 2.
 
 

 2
 
 
Jabalpur Division First floor in campus Head Post Office Civil Line Jabalpur - 482001

 
 Exactly same as Address 1.
 
 

 3
 
 
Jabalpur Division First floor in campus Head Post Office Civil Line Jabalpur - 480001

 
 Different because PIN code 482001 is written as 480001.
 
 

 4
 
 
Jabalpur Division First floor in campus Head Post Office Civil Lane Jabalpur - 482001

 
 Different because Civil Line is written as Civil Lane.
 
 

Thus, the two addresses which are exactly the same are 1 and 2.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
